name.zh: 金血忆灵•裁定忘却之形（完整）

zh.name: 金血忆灵•裁定忘却之形（完整）
zh.desc: 代码受到影响后的完整投影。参照本体为金血忆灵•裁定忘却之形，那众多金血忆灵的残躯中一丝尚存的疯狂，被长夜月抽取提炼，融合成了更为扭曲怪异的怪物。\n它将遵守造物主的指示，裁定何物应被记起，何物应被忘却，它会吞噬掉徒劳无功的冗余记忆，使它们在岁月中沉默。\n「新的生命若要萌芽，它的种子须是死的。」

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体目标造成大量虚数属性伤害，若目标持有护盾则削减自身韧性，该削韧效果不会使韧性低于1点。
召唤【金血忆灵•雉形】，每个召唤物被消灭时，削减自身韧性。
锁定指定我方角色，使自身的速度提高，并在数个回合内对该目标施放【罪血嚼齿】和【罪血锯刑】。施放该技能后再行动1次。
对指定我方单体目标造成大量虚数属性伤害，使目标降低生命值的一部分转化为【<u>侵蚀</u>】，若目标持有护盾则削减自身韧性，该削韧效果不会使韧性低于1点。

240320101.name: 侵蚀
240320101.desc: 攻击后回复侵蚀部分的生命值，击中的目标数量越多，回复的生命值越高。受到伤害时，降低生命值的一部分转化为侵蚀。消耗生命值时，降低的生命值会全部转化为侵蚀。通过回复生命值的方式解除侵蚀时，使自身获得【焕新】效果。【焕新】：下次攻击造成的伤害提高。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体目标造成大量虚数属性伤害，使目标降低生命值的一部分转化为【<u>侵蚀</u>】。

240320101.name: 侵蚀
240320101.desc: 攻击后回复侵蚀部分的生命值，击中的目标数量越多，回复的生命值越高。受到伤害时，降低生命值的一部分转化为侵蚀。消耗生命值时，降低的生命值会全部转化为侵蚀。通过回复生命值的方式解除侵蚀时，使自身获得【焕新】效果。【焕新】：下次攻击造成的伤害提高。

skill_list.skill_desc: 进入蓄力状态，下次行动时施放【罪血枭首】，选择1名没有被【指名祸首】选中过的我方角色承受【罪血枭首】的最高伤害和【<u>罪血腐蚀</u>】。当所有角色都被【指名祸首】选中过时，可任意选择目标。

240620202.name: 罪血腐蚀
240620202.desc: 回合开始时受到固定数值虚数属性伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对被【指名祸首】选中的角色以外的我方角色造成虚数属性伤害，对被【指名祸首】选中的我方角色造成大量虚数属性伤害，并根据该角色受到的未被护盾抵消的伤害的数值，对其施加【<u>罪血腐蚀</u>】。

240620202.name: 罪血腐蚀
240620202.desc: 回合开始时受到固定数值虚数属性伤害。

skill_list.skill_desc: 未被弱点击破时，受到的伤害降低，被弱点击破时行动额外延后，并对自身造成大量虚数属性伤害，被弱点击破后，受到的伤害提高。
每当施放可以施加【<u>侵蚀</u>】效果的技能后，自身造成的伤害小幅提高。

en.name: Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion (Complete)
en.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion. A trace of lingering madness extracted and refined by Evernight from the countless corpses of ichor memosprites, then synthesized into more twisted and grotesque monsters.\nIt shall follow the creator's directive, determining what should be remembered and what should be forgotten, devouring redundant memories that serve no purpose and leaving them muted in the flow of time.\n"If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead."

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.
Summons "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant." For every summon defeated, reduces this unit's Toughness.
Locks on to one designated character, increases this unit's SPD, and uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" on the target within several turns. Take 1 extra action after using this ability.

Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP into "<u>Corrosion</u>." If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

240320101.name: Corrosion
240320101.desc: After attacking, restore a portion of Corroded HP. The more targets are hit, the more HP is restored. When taking DMG, a portion of the HP reduced is converted to Corrosion. When HP is consumed, the reduced HP will all be converted to Corrosion. When Corrosion is dispelled via restorative means, this unit obtains "Renewal." "Renewal" increases the DMG dealt by the next attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

240320101.name: Corrosion
240320101.desc: After attacking, restore a portion of Corroded HP. The more targets are hit, the more HP is restored. When taking DMG, a portion of the HP reduced is converted to Corrosion. When HP is consumed, the reduced HP will all be converted to Corrosion. When Corrosion is dispelled via restorative means, this unit obtains "Renewal." "Renewal" increases the DMG dealt by the next attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Enter the Charging state. In the next action, uses "Hemotort Decapitation" and selects 1 ally character who has not been targeted by "Name the Culprit" before to take the maximum DMG from "Hemotort Decapitation" and "<u>Hemotort Corruption</u>". When all characters have been targeted by "Name the Culprit," you can select any target.

240620202.name: Hemotort Corruption
240620202.desc: Take a set amount of Imaginary DMG at the beginning of the turn.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Imaginary Type DMG to target characters not selected with "Name the Culprit." Deals massive Imaginary Type DMG to target characters selected with "Name the Culprit," and applies "<u>Hemotort Corruption</u>" based on the amount of DMG taken (not offset by Shield) to the selected characters.

240620202.name: Hemotort Corruption
240620202.desc: Take a set amount of Imaginary DMG at the beginning of the turn.

skill_list.skill_desc: Reduces DMG received when not Weakness Broken. When this unit is Weakness Broken, its action will be further delayed, and deals massive Imaginary DMG to this unit. While Weakness Broken, this unit receives increased DMG.
After using an ability that can apply the "<u>Corrosion</u>" effect, DMG dealt by this unit is slightly increased.
